content.content:
example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[ \-()]*(\+[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){8,15}|0[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){6,13}|[1-9][ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){5,12})$'
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.E164NationalLength"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          pattern: '^\d{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-04'
          x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, an ageBand is derived from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
          x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creation even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' from the last name and a global owner sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners at the same address with the same last name.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C1B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key joining the normalized telephone, the email (or empty) and the household id with '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity key matches.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3F2A9C1B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' from the customer code and the registration date's year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

## Summary

I made the `householdId` deterministic from `(lastName, postcode)` and reworked the household/duplicate handling to key off it. Changes were kept small and confined to simple functions:

1. **`HouseholdId.java`** (tiny class): `of(lastName, postcode)` now hashes `normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode`, so owners with the same last name and postcode get the same 12-hex-char id automatically. (Only the input source changed — the SHA-256/hex formatting is untouched.)

2. **`Owner.getHouseholdId()`**: one-line change to feed `postcode` instead of `address`. Since MapStruct maps this straight to `OwnerDto.householdId`, the API output is now the deterministic value.

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1`**:
   - `sameHousehold(a, b)` now compares the computed `getHouseholdId()` (last name + postcode) instead of last name + address. This is reused by the household-size (`householdMemberCount`) computation, so that input keys off the computed id.
   - Added a household-duplicate block: if any existing owner shares the household id, return **409** unless the request sets `sharesHousehold`, which bypasses the block and creates the owner as a declared member.
   - A created owner is no longer flagged as a possible duplicate (`possibleDuplicate=false`, `possibleDuplicateOf=null`) — a declared member is not a suspected duplicate, and any non-declared same-household create is now rejected before that point. Removed the now-unused `PossibleDuplicate` import.

Behavior verified: same last name + postcode → same `householdId` (with `sharesHousehold` needed for the second create); different last name, same postcode → different `householdId`. `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0 — BUILD SUCCESS`.

Structural impact stayed low — four small edits across three files, each in a low-complexity function, with the `HouseholdId` hashing body and the `getIdentityKey`/`MembershipLevel` code left untouched.
